shorts.title: A fund house earns 53 paise on ₹100. Who gave way?

beats.say: What does a mutual fund company earn on every hundred rupees it looks after?

beats.say: At ICICI Prudential, fifty three paise a year, by its own measure. It keeps thirty seven as profit, before tax.
